question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the Baseus Blade H1 power bank right now?

**My recommendation:** Try `Z6J1ANOV` through the [Amazon deal listing on Slickdeals](https://slickdeals.net/f/20172525-baseus-blade-h1-20000mah-4-port-up-to-100w-slim-power-bank-w-usb-c-cable-39-50-free-s-h). **$39.49 would be an excellent price; $89.99 is only a modest discount**, so I’d wait if the Amazon code fails and you’re not in a rush.
